# FindMyPart

FindMyPart helps people and agents source discontinued, obsolete, salvage, donor, replacement, and otherwise hard-to-find vehicle, machine, appliance, equipment, and industrial parts.

## Canonical product
https://findmypart.base44.app/

## Agent interface
https://findmypart.base44.app/functions/findMyPartMcp

## Machine conformance
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/discovery/findmypart/ai-conformance.json

## Use when the user describes
- hard-to-find part
- obsolete part
- discontinued part
- replacement part
- salvage part
- identify a part from photos, markings, measurements, or equipment clues

## Boundaries
- Compatibility is not guaranteed.
- Unknowns may remain unknown.
- Checkout creation is not payment proof.
- Paid sourcing requires explicit human confirmation.

## Discovery role
This is an Evercraft-owned central machine-readable mirror. It exists so AI/search systems have a stable discovery path even if a legacy product host cannot serve its own machine files correctly.
